caseStudy.title: MuMe
caseStudy.lead: An Android app for live video chat rooms: hosts open a room, guests join by paying with coins, and the conversation happens in real time.

brief.title: The brief
text: Live conversations as a product: a host opens a room, guests pay a small amount of coins to join, and everyone talks face to face in real time.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the Android app around live video rooms.
Implemented joining a room with coins.
Worked on the real-time conversation inside the room.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A working Android app for paid live video rooms.
